title: E0120: Eval with user-controlled string
plain_english: Calling `eval()` with a string that includes user-controlled input allows arbitrary PHP code execution.
why_matters: `eval()` with user input is a critical security risk: - An attacker can execute arbitrary system commands - It can lead to full server compromise - Data on the server may be read, modified, or deleted
what_it_checks: `eval()` calls where the string argument contains tainted input
String concatenation inside `eval()` with user-controlled variables
